item.title: ‘The Further Mis-Adventures Of Cliff Booth’ Review: The Vibes Are Off In David Fincher’s Dark, Dank, Grubby Tarantino Episode
item.description: There’s a strong argument to be made that if you’ve read Quentin Tarantino ’s “ Once Upon A Time In Hollywood ” novelization, “ The Further Mis-Adventures Of Cliff Booth ” shouldn’t surprise you. Tarantino’s book was shaggy and baggy, like an unedited, freehand version of the movie, full of detours, tangents, and narrative cul-de-sacs. An interesting extended curiosity, mildly entertaining in spots, but much of it probably wouldn’t have stood on its own outside the pulp novel format.
